# `hypot`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
hypot(expr1, expr2)
```

Returns sqrt(`expr1`² + `expr2`²).

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql

> SELECT hypot(3, 4);
```
